SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2) AS items,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) FROM fdbk_g2) AS fdbk_refs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id) AS joined,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL) AS null_prc_usd,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL) AS null_usd_but_cents

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id,
         COUNT(*) AS review_ct,
         AVG(f.rtg) AS avg_review_rtg,
         COALESCE(i.prc_usd, i.prc / 100.0) AS price_usd
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING price_usd > 50
     AND review_ct >= 5
     AND avg_review_rtg < 3.0
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS using_items_avg_rtg
FROM items_g2 i
JOIN (
  SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) AS review_ct
  FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id
) s ON s.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd, i.prc/100.0) > 50
  AND s.review_ct >= 5
  AND i.avg_rtg < 3.0
